shared_elements: monolithic standing figure/pillar carved in low relief
circular disc motif on the body
schematic motifs arranged in stacked zones on a vertical shaft
small emblematic/repeated signs in a row across the upper part
justification: Both depict an upright anthropomorphic monolith whose body carries shallow relief organised into stacked zones, with a horizontal belt-like band crossing the shaft and disc/circle motifs plus a row of small repeated emblem-signs in the upper zone. The decisive difference is content: A is populated with recognisable animals in profile (birds, quadrupeds, a snake-like form) and a small human figure interacting across the surface, whereas B's body is covered almost entirely by abstract discs, bands and geometric ornaments with a distinct sculpted head and headdress and no animal scene.
